verdict.rationale: Bruno is explicitly offline-only with "No cloud sync. No account. No login." and has no plans to ever add cloud sync. Collections are stored as plain-text Bru files in a local filesystem folder, and versioning works through local Git. A community user confirms switching to Bruno specifically to avoid Postman's mandatory cloud account. missing for 10: no hands-on corroboration that every feature (e.g. the Git UI and docs publishing) works with no network connectivity at all.
